messages.content: 在壓力為10千帕的情況下，水的凝固點是多少？

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which to calculate the boiling point.

pressure.description: The pressure at which to calculate the boiling point. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit of the pressure. Default is 'kPa'.

message.content:
在 10 kPa（約 0.1 atm）下，水的凝固點大約是 **–0.2 °C**（約 –0.3 °C，取決於精確的熱力學參數）。  

這個值比標準大氣壓（101.3 kPa）下的 0 °C 稍低，因為水的熔點隨壓力下降而略降。實際數值會因測量條件（純度、溶質等）略有差異，但通常在 –0.1 °C 到 –0.3 °C 之間。

Let's recall: For water, the melting curve has negative slope: increasing pressure lowers melting point. So at 10 kPa, which is lower than 101.3 kPa, the freezing point is slightly higher? Wait, the slope dT/dP = -TΔV/ΔS. For water, ΔV (solid minus liquid) is negative (ice less dense), so ΔV < 0, so dT/dP > 0? Actually ΔV = V_solid - V_liquid. Ice has larger volume, so ΔV > 0. So dT/dP = -TΔV/ΔS. ΔS = S_solid - S_liquid < 0 (since solid has lower entropy). So ΔS < 0. So -TΔV/ΔS = -T*(positive)/(negative) = positive. So dT/dP > 0.
